test_semantics.direct_preservation: A comparator directly preserves a frozen distinction only when it has an explicit role capable of representing that distinction without hiding/retyping it inside another role.
test_semantics.limitation: This is a strict representational-preservation/minimality test, not a theorem that no richer encoding into a weaker formalism is mathematically possible.

rationale: Pi, C, Q, interface direction and rho/O are independently frozen across multiple lanes.
Encoding them into X or K would erase distinctions that the reverse projection explicitly preserved.
The only claim whose instantiated role set is a subset of {X,K,T}, CH01.C1, still has a source-context residual.

generalized_Q_pressure: Q appears in 36/60 claims across all ten lanes.
Frozen witnesses include correctness criteria, thresholds, reference-relative classification, relevance filters, uncertainty comparisons, and other non-scalar orientation structures.
A standard scalar reward reading therefore does not directly preserve the frozen Q family.
observation_direction_pressure: LRN residuals contain observation-to-latent epistemic/estimation relations.
CH-B includes O->X and O->O topology without a clean X->O rho readout.
Therefore a single outward state-generated observation interpretation is too narrow for lossless claim representation.
comparator_G_pomdp_like.rationale: A POMDP-like tuple captures much of the X/P/K/O/Q/T backbone, but direct preservation loses explicit Pi, explicit C, P_in/P_out directionality, generalized Q semantics, and some O/rho orientation.

Pi.loss_if_removed: Nested-role/subsystem/classification individuation must be hidden in X or relation labels.

C.loss_if_removed: Realizability/admissibility/resource/process constraints collapse into K/Q/context despite frozen distinctions.

Q.loss_if_removed: Criterion-conditioned filtering/orientation becomes indistinguishable from dynamics or observation.

P_in.loss_if_removed: External intervention/write operations collapse into internal K.

P_out.loss_if_removed: Probe/query/read operations collapse into observation carriers or generic K.

K.loss_if_removed: Typed transformation/dependence topology cannot be recovered from temporal order alone.

T.loss_if_removed: Precedence/succession/temporal scope becomes conflated with K.

rho/O.loss_if_removed: Observed traces/readouts and their nonterminal uses collapse into X or P.

X.loss_if_removed: No configuration carrier remains for internal structure/state roles.

conclusions.strongest_result: Every Grammar-v0 role has independent cross-lane witnesses, and both G_dyn and a POMDP-like comparator lose frozen distinctions unless they add ad hoc encodings that effectively reintroduce the omitted roles.
conclusions.residual_implication: Residual adjudication establishes no new ROLE_GAP; failures principally concern source-context parameters, relation/assertion language, formal carrier directionality, and underidentified derived structure.
conclusions.next_step: Separate the system grammar from claim-language/formal-carrier extensions in manuscript architecture; optionally formalize comparator morphisms/forgetful maps without altering v0.
